# Marketing

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-port.py from catalogue/departments.toml and the skills folder. Do not edit by hand. -->

Customer Insights - Journeys and Customer Insights - Data delivery: journeys, segments, email and text channels, forms and events, consent and preference centres, deliverability, lead scoring and hand-off, and profile unification.

## Install

Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add SimonFoote-greensparx/dynamics-365-ce-roster
/plugin install marketing@dynamics-365-ce-roster
```

ChatGPT and Codex: add this repository as a plugin marketplace, or copy this folder into `.agents/skills/` in your project.

## Skills

| Skill | What it covers | Status |
|---|---|---|
| [`marketing:consent-and-preference-centre`](skills/consent-and-preference-centre/SKILL.md) | Designs the consent model and preference centre for Customer Insights - Journeys, mapping UK GDPR and PECR questions, including soft opt-in, onto contact point consent, purposes, topics and compliance profiles. Use when setting up consent, migrating legacy opt-ins, building a preference centre, or checking whether a message may be sent. | draft |
| [`marketing:customer-profile-unification`](skills/customer-profile-unification/SKILL.md) | Designs unified customer profiles in Customer Insights - Data, covering source selection, source mapping, deduplication, match rules, merge policies and use of profiles in journeys and Dynamics 365 apps. Use when combining customer data from several systems, tuning match rules, or deciding whether Customer Insights - Data is needed at all. | draft |
| [`marketing:email-and-sms-channels`](skills/email-and-sms-channels/SKILL.md) | Designs the email and text message channels in Customer Insights - Journeys, covering templates, content blocks, personalisation, sender identity, SMS providers and numbers, opt-out keywords and message testing. Use when setting up email or SMS for the first time, building a template set, or deciding which messages belong on which channel. | draft |
| [`marketing:email-deliverability`](skills/email-deliverability/SKILL.md) | Plans email deliverability for Customer Insights - Journeys, covering sending domain strategy, domain authentication with SPF, DKIM and DMARC, warm-up, list hygiene and sender reputation monitoring. Use when authenticating domains, planning the first sends from a new platform, or investigating marketing email landing in spam or bouncing. | draft |
| [`marketing:forms-and-events`](skills/forms-and-events/SKILL.md) | Designs marketing forms and event management in Customer Insights - Journeys, covering form fields, contact and lead matching, consent capture, embedding, spam protection, registration, check-in and follow-up. Use when building sign-up or enquiry forms, running webinars or in-person events, or fixing duplicates created by form submissions. | draft |
| [`marketing:journey-design`](skills/journey-design/SKILL.md) | Designs real-time journeys in Customer Insights - Journeys, covering trigger and segment entry, custom triggers, branching, waits, goals, exit and re-entry rules, testing and go-live. Use when planning a welcome, nurture, onboarding, renewal or event journey, choosing triggers, or moving journeys off older outbound marketing. | draft |
| [`marketing:lead-scoring-and-sales-handoff`](skills/lead-scoring-and-sales-handoff/SKILL.md) | Designs lead scoring in Customer Insights - Journeys and the hand-off of sales-ready leads to Dynamics 365 Sales with journey context, covering fit and interest signals, thresholds, assignment, follow-up expectations and feedback. Use when defining marketing qualified leads, building a scoring model, or fixing leads that sellers ignore. | draft |
| [`marketing:segments-and-audiences`](skills/segments-and-audiences/SKILL.md) | Designs segments and audiences for Customer Insights - Journeys, covering audience sources, attribute and behavioural conditions, inclusions, exclusions, suppression and refresh. Use when building a campaign audience, choosing between Dataverse contacts, leads or unified profiles, or fixing segments that include or miss the wrong people. | draft |
